File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Trim trailing carriage returns (`\r`) as well as empty strings when normalizing statement lines in `parseStatement`, ensuring files with CRLF line endings do not leave an empty line that causes a Malformed row error.
args.title: Handle CRLF line endings in parseStatement

parseStatement fails on files with CRLF line endings because trailing carriage returns are not popped like empty strings.
